title: ISO 20022 Schema-Subset Tables & Validators
description: Hand-derived schema-subset field tables for pain.001.001.09 (plus the .12 delta) and camt.053.001, with zero-dependency structural and facet validators: IBAN mod-97, BIC format, ISO 4217/3166 code lists, decimal/date facets, and batch-total cross-checks (control sum, transaction count, opening/closing balance). Subset validation, not full XSD conformance.

mcp_tool_definition.name: iso20022_schema_subset_validate
mcp_tool_definition.description: Validates a pain.001.001.09 or camt.053.001 ISO 20022 XML message against a hand-derived schema-subset table: structural presence, maxLength, pattern facets, IBAN mod-97, BIC format, ISO 4217/3166 code-list membership, and batch-total cross-checks (control sum vs. sum of amounts, transaction count, opening/closing balance reconciliation). Returns a structured error list. Subset validation, not full XSD conformance. Does not generate or transmit live payment messages.
